bugreport.title: Report a bug
bugreport.intro: Describe the problem, and your browser opens a new issue on GitHub with your text, facts about your computer and the open map, and the log filled in. You need a GitHub account to send it.
bugreport.intro.crash: The last session ended without MapWorks closing normally, by a crash or because it had to be ended. A report helps to find out why: say what you were doing, and your browser opens GitHub with the report and the log of that session filled in.
bugreport.field.title: Title
bugreport.field.title.tooltip: One line that names the problem, such as "Junction arms jump when turned"
bugreport.field.what.tooltip: What you saw, and any message MapWorks showed
bugreport.field.steps.tooltip: What you did before, step by step, and which map; the more exact, the faster it can be fixed
bugreport.field.expected.tooltip: What you expected to happen instead
bugreport.log.attach.tooltip: The end of MapWorks' log goes into the report; the whole log lies ready in a folder to drag into the issue
bugreport.send.tooltip: Opens GitHub's form for a new issue in your browser, filled in; nothing is sent before you press Submit there
bugreport.included: Goes along: MapWorks' version, Windows, graphics card, processor and memory{what, select, crashlog {, the end of the crashed session's log and Unity's crash report if there is one} crash {} maplog {, the open map and the end of the log} other {, the open map}}. {log, select, yes {The whole log lies ready in a folder that opens, to drag into the issue. } other {}}Your Windows user folder shows as %USERPROFILE%, keys of picture sources are left out. You see everything on GitHub before you submit it.
@bugreport.included: {what} and {log} are words that choose the parts of the sentence (crashlog, crash, maplog, map; yes, no): keep them in English
bugreport.status: Report a bug: GitHub opens in your browser with the report filled in{clipboard, select, no {, the whole report is on the clipboard to paste} other {}}{hasfile, select, yes {; drag {file} from the folder that opened into the issue} other {}}, then press Submit.
@bugreport.status: {clipboard} and {hasfile} are yes or no and choose the parts of the sentence: keep them in English; {file} is a file name, shown unchanged
